reader.requirement: At --std 85 no line of a page footing report group may be presented below integer-1 of the PAGE clause; the PF's first line is absolute (XIII.3.15.3 SR9), so every placement is static and a PF line past the page limit (absolute, or a relative tail) is refused, while a PF ending on integer-1 is legal.

edition-consulted.switches: year changes only the report footing's upper limit; the PF arm (Footing+1, PageLimit) is edition-blind
Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 refuses a relative first LINE clause in a page footing (XIII.3.15.3 SR9)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel in ReportSectionBinder.cs and Edition in ReportWriter.cs
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 1985 a PF's first LINE clause must be absolute (refused otherwise), which makes the lower limit fully static; 2002 and later admit a relative first line placed from FOOTING
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1270 puts the PF on its upper limit, not on the page limit, and no refused PF past the limit

probes.printed: PF on LINE 11 and LINE 12 (= PAGE LIMIT 12)
COBOL2199 integer-1 13 exceeds the page limit 12; absolute LINE 13 of page footing lies below the lower limit 12
COBOL2199 relative lines at the end of page footing 'PF1' carry its last line to line 13, past the lower limit 12
COBOL2199 first LINE clause of a page footing is relative ... (ISO §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9)
COBOL0899 TYPE PageFooting requires a PAGE clause

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR2  (3.10.9 Page Footing Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR2
OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8e  (3.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR8e
OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9  (3.15.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR9

reader.notes: GroupLimits gives the page footing the page limit as its lower limit and ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute line or a relative tail past it; the boundary itself prints. With the 1985 absolute-first rule no run-time placement of a PF can differ from the static one.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the PAGE clause's implicit values (1985 XIII.3.8.4 GR2), which the reader did not probe: e1_pf_nofooting_past (PAGE 12 ... LAST DETAIL 9, no FOOTING, PF LINE 12 + PLUS 1) refused: 'relative lines at the end of page footing report group PF1 carry its last line to line 13, past the group's lower limit 12'; e2_pf_nofooting_ok (PF 11, PLUS 1) prints FA 11, FB 12; e3_pf_page_only (PAGE 12 alone: integer-4 = integer-5 = 12, so the PF region is 13..12, empty) refuses LINE 12 as 'above the upper limit 13' and the tail as past 12; g2_pf_two_abs (LINE 10, LINE 12, LINE PLUS 0 on the page limit) prints FB FZ on 12. c4 'LINE PLUS 2 ON NEXT PAGE' refused. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR2 ... the text is in GR2'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2c ... the text is in GR2c'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2e ... the text is in GR2e'. Side observation (not this rule's verdict): the 1985 refusals cite §2023:13.18.35.3 SR6 d) and §2023:13.18.57.4 rather than the 1985 clause.
